Ada: Heads-up — vending machine got a new stock. Quick poll: salty vs sweet? Vote with emoji. :salt: = salty, :candy: = sweet. State a one-liner why.
Jose: :salt: chips forever.
Mei: :candy: sour gummies > everything :)
Priya: :salt: pretzels if we can get the mini bags.
Alex: :candy: but dark chocolate pls.
Sam (office-admin): Thanks y'all — I'll place an order Friday based on majority and try to include GF options. @everyone if you've allergies say now.
SnackBot: Current reactions tally (auto): salty — 2, sweet — 2
Priya: adding +1 for pretzels. also can we get some no-sugar candy?
Ada: also curious — any peanut allergies? @office-admin
Jose: none here.
Mei: tree nut allergy — please avoid almond bars.
Sam (office-admin): Noted. I'll mark 'may contain nuts' and avoid loose bulk nuts. Ordering: chips, pretzels, sour gummies, dark chocolate squares, and GF cookie packs.
Alex: :thumbsup: perfect.
Ada: thanks! snack day Friday :celebrate:
